deviations.claim_in_article: “They were enjoying the convenience of AI, only to find a human on the other end of the call without realizing it.”
deviations.issue: The article presents users’ lack of awareness as an actual event. The Ledger establishes that the test began without proper disclosure, but does not establish that users did not realize a human was handling their calls.
deviations.explanation: This adds an unverified claim about users’ actual awareness and states it more definitively than the Ledger supports. The Japanese source already contains the same implication, so this is not newly introduced by translation.
deviations.qualifier_text: Nearby: “might think,” “in some cases,” and “if this was not properly explained.”
